metadata.malware_name: Cloud and AI-agent platform intrusion toolkit (INV-2026-082)
metadata.family: Operator-written Python tooling: scripted LLM endpoint, MCP plant, reverse SOCKS relay, receive-only sinks, around one open-directory VPS
metadata.notes: Operator-side values only: the operator's VPS, ports, URL paths, operator-written script hashes and operator-chosen strings. No victim value of any kind (no victim address, host, credential, token, account or project id). Stock public tools (fscan, gogo) are not listed as hashes: their hashes match anyone using the public tool. bore.pub and 159.223.110.159 are a shared public tunnel service and sit in hunt_only_never_block. Execution of the operator scripts on a victim is shown only where the case notes say so.

WHOIS for 198.44.116.0/24 names Hostwinds LLC while Vantage and VirusTotal show another AS owner label; the abuse contact was not checked. hunt_only_never_block.role: third-party public tunnel rendezvous (open-source bore, free public server); used by the operator, not operated by the operator
hunt_only_never_block.context: The operator runs the bore client on the VPS and in the pod and publishes local ports at bore.pub:<port>. The operator's fixed port is 1811 (claim1811.sh, take1811.sh; about 35 scripts). Other remote ports are random assignments per session. Blocking the host takes out every other bore user; hunt for it, do not feed it to a blocklist.
hunt_only_never_block.false_positive_note: Shared public service. Do not block.

hunt_only_never_block.role: third-party: the public A record of bore.pub (DigitalOcean AS14061)
hunt_only_never_block.context: Hard-coded as the tunnel host in mxpod.py, muxpod.py, mxpod2.py, mcpx.py and pod_gogo.py. VirusTotal rates it 16 of 92 engines malicious because of bore abuse by many users. Not an operator server and not a second party (HIGH).
hunt_only_never_block.false_positive_note: Shared public service. Do not block.

hunt_only_never_block.role: operator-claimed remote port on the shared bore server
hunt_only_never_block.context: A host:port on a third-party server. Useful to find in egress logs or agent baseUrl values; the port alone is not a block on bore.pub. Agent configs whose llm.baseUrl or MCP command points here are the operator's.
hunt_only_never_block.false_positive_note: Shared public service. Do not block the host.
